method: Playwright 1.64 driving the installed Google Chrome in headed mode against product builds started by apps/local-runtime/dist/cli.js with PostgreSQL 18.6

flows.name: personal activity create, close, reload and reopen
steps: first entry shows the personal learning space without an account
create an activity from a goal and a multi-line Chinese question
close the activity and observe the closed state
reload the page and find the same activity still closed
reopen it and observe the active state again

flows.name: school account login, activity and logout
steps: school page shows the real account form
log in with the member created through xunjie school-member
create an activity and reopen it after reload
log out; the form returns and the activity is no longer shown

flows.name: installed client connects a school through the school approval page
steps: start a connection from the installed client with the school entry
open the authorization page on the school origin and log in
approve the client and complete the connection
switch to the school space and create an activity through the client proxy
revoke the connection; the school space disappears and the client keeps zero local grant files

errors: GET /favicon.ico returns 404 on the product web entry (cosmetic; no flow depends on it)

limitations: Apple Silicon Mac Chrome acceptance was not executed on this Windows host.
Both product instances ran on one Windows machine over loopback; this does not prove cross-machine networking or public TLS.
